relationships.subject: HMGB1
relationships.evidence_quote: OHP determined a neuroinflammatory state in DRG neurons by the increase in matrix metalloproteinase-9 (MMP-9) levels due to TLR4/PI3K/akt signaling cascade activated by high-mobility group box 1 (HMGB-1), which was released by neurons and macrophages.

relationships.subject: p38 MAPK
relationships.evidence_quote: These data suggested that the CDDP-driven p38 MAPK phosphorylation led to an increase of PGE2 release by glial cells that in turn stimulated the activation of PGE receptors expressed on the ganglia neurons cell membrane.

relationships.subject: PGE2
relationships.evidence_quote: Therefore, this process could modulate the neuronal activity through the activation of second messenger cascades resulting in TRPV1 activation and thus sensitization of sensory neurons (54).

relationships.subject: cisplatin
relationships.evidence_quote: showed that CDDP-induced mechanical allodynia was reduced in trl3 -/- and tlr4 -/- mice compared to WT animals

key_findings: Review: neuroinflammation (cytokines, chemokines, TLR4/HMGB1/MMP-9 signaling, glial activation) contributes to platinum-induced CIPN in rodent models.
Cisplatin-driven p38 MAPK in satellite glial cells increases PGE2 release, linked to TRPV1 sensitization in DRG neurons.
